edits.before: - Sivir Spell Shield: matchup-defining — Eats your key spell and refunds her mana — bait it with a cheap cast first. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Supercharger (evolved stealth) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Sivir's Spell Shield (E) is down 24s early, 18s late — bait it with a cheap cast before you commit your key spell. - Her W (12s) resets on champion takedowns, so it's rarely truly down. - Her R (120/100/80s) buys her team a fight, not poke — respect the speed window.
